CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

January 14, 2025

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 6:59 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER

Absent:
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: December 10, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the December 10, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  2810 West Alhambra Road, DRB-2024-00125

  •  Request: This is an application for a new sign and exterior façade improvements
  on an existing 1-story commercial building for business known as ‘Dollar Tree’.
  •  Applicant: Angel Martinez

  1
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Any changes to the translucent window vinyl must be reviewed and approved
  by the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Any future changes to the translucent window vinyl must be reviewed and
  approved by the Design Review Board.
  2. Revise coping/trim paint color to be a complementary accent color to the
  existing stucco wall.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  1820 Alta Vista Drive, DRB-2024-00141

  •  Request: This is an application for new exterior improvements, including new
  stucco finish to CMU walls and new tile finish to stairs and walkways, on an existing
  2-story single-family residence.
  •  Applicant: Michael Lin
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  115 South Electric Avenue, DRB-2024-00047

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 756 SF detached 2nd dwelling unit with
  an attached covered carport located at the rear of the property visible from the
  corner street side.
  •  Applicant: Yun Yun Wu
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

  2
 MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  Conditions of Approval:
  1. Update drawings to show at least a 6” wide post at the front porch.
  2. Provide a low wall on both sides of the front porch between the building face
  and post and height aligned with top of window sill.
  3. Update window sill thickness to match the existing window sill of the front unit
  and remove any notation of 2” min.
  4. Show the location of proposed outdoor mechanical equipment including, but
  not limited to, heat pump and condenser unit.
  5. Update reflected ceiling plans to identify the location and type for the proposed
  porch lighting.
  6. Identify on the plans and/or window schedule the proposed window frame color
  and material.
  7. Remove the belt/string course detail from the walls and post.
  8. Lower the front porch header to provide a heavier header appearance.
  9. Provide a note that attic vent/louvers are to be painted to match stucco color.
  10. Remove the word “painted” from the proposed front door and maintain a natural
  wood finish.
  11. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:52 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on January 28, 2025.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:52 P.M.
  •  The second was by Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
